question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated control over the Chinese Communist Party and military, with no visible rivals or succession signals, underpins the 95.3% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Analysts widely anticipate he will secure a fourth term at the 21st Party Congress later in 2027, continuing the pattern established at prior congresses amid ongoing anti-corruption campaigns and elite reshuffles that favor his allies. Recent diplomatic engagements, including 2026 summits, have shown no erosion of his authority. Still, low-probability events such as an abrupt health crisis, major undisclosed scandal, or sudden elite realignment could shift dynamics before year-end, though current reporting shows no such indicators.
